notes.title: Santa's Visit Holiday Update is HERE!!!!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the Holiday 2020 title update for Santa's Visit is now live! Come and experience the magic of Christmas with a whole set of new content!

In this update, we've added a host of new toys, many musical themed, new VR interactions, more classic movies to enjoy, steam achievements and 15 hidden treats around the living room with a special surprise waiting for you if you manage to find them all. 

In addition to new content, Santa's Visit got a total graphics overhaul. Assets were outright remade to make the experience look as beautiful as possible for all your new shiny headsets. Yes that's right Oculus Quest 2 owners, we're lookin' at you! Santa's Visit has been tested on the Quest 2 and is fully compatible so come give it a shot!

Cheers and Happy Holidays!
- Virtual Anarchy Studios




For more information, you can visit our blog at:
https://www.virtualanarchystudios.com/blog/

notes.title: Santa's Visit Title Update!
notes.content:
Virtual Anarchy Studios recently took over the development of Santa's Visit and would love to welcome new VR owners to taste the magic of Christmas! This is the first major title update Santa's Visit has seen since it launched last November. The elves are working hard and we're exited to announce that the update will soon be in your hands within the next few days!

In this year's content update, you'll find a set of new toys; many musical themed, new VR interactions, a host of new steam achievements, more Christmas films to watch, and 15 hidden goodies discretely placed around the living room with a surprise waiting for you if you manage to find them all. We've also taken the time to remaster many many of the visuals around the room to make the experience as stellar and beautiful as possible for all of your shiny new headsets!

Note that Santa's Visit has been developed and tested on Oculus hardware and is fully compatible with the Oculus PCVR family which includes the newly released Quest 2. WMR, Vive and other HMDs may also work but aren't officially supported just yet, although we have had people successfully play through with some WMR devices. 

We can't wait to see what types of experiences you all have with the game so be rest assured that we'll have a close eye on the inter-webs for your videos, screenshots and stories. ;)

Cheers and happy holidays!
- Virtual Anarchy Studios
